Report Description
////MARINE POLLUTION SURVEILLANCE REPORTS /// POSSIBLE OIL OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 62 MILES SOUTHEAST OF LEVITTOWN, NY. THE ANOMALY APPEARS TO BE COMING FROM THE COIMBRA SHIPWRECK WHICH IS A KNOWN LEAK SOURCE.. THE ANOMALY IS 7.4 MILES IN TOTAL LENGTH AND 0.20 MILES IN WIDTH. THE SUSPECTED OIL ANOMALY HAS GOOD CONTRAST AGAINST THE OCEAN SURFACE AND EXHIBITS SHARP TURNS. THE DROP OUTS FROM THE SATELLITE IMAGE SEEM TO OBSCURE THE OVERALL EXTENT OF THE OIL. IN ADDITION, OCEAN SWELLS APPEAR NEAR AND SOUTH OF THE AREA OF POSSIBLE OF OIL SHOWING UP AS BRIGHT WHITE LINES IN THE IMAGE. WINDS WERE LIGHT AT LESS THAN 10 KNOTS COMING FROM THE WSW. UNCERTAINTIES: THE DROP OUTS FROM THE SATELLITE IMAGE SEEM TO OBSCURE THE OVERALL EXTENT OF THE OIL; THERE MAY HAVE BEEN ADDITIONAL OIL ALONG THE SOUTHERN EDGE ALTHOUGH THIS AREA DOESN"T HAVE THE SAME APPEARANCE IN CONTRAST WITH ALL THE OTHER ANOMALIES.

HEPACO IS RESPONDING TO INSPECT THE CARS TO DETERMINE IF THERE HAS BEEN A PRODUCT RELEASE. NOTIFICATIONS ARE PENDING HEPACO’S INSPECTION OF THE CARS.

THIS IS LOCATED IN THE OSBORN YARD IN LOUISVILLE, KY. CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER WAS CONFERENCED IN WITH THE CALLER. DISPATCHER LOUISVILLE METROSAFE CONSOLIDATED COMMUNICATIONS, WAS NOTIFIED AND FIRE DEPARTMENT IS RESPONDING. TRAINMASTER WAS UPDATED. SPECIAL AGENT, WAS NOTIFIED. (RC)

Report Description\\ NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: TRAIN DERAILMENT DANGEROUS GOODS INTO WATER | DUPONT CANADA | KINGSTON, ON \\ AT 10:35 ET ON 05 MAY 2023, A CN RAIL TRAIN DERAILMENT IN KINGSTON, ON (INTERSECTION OF BATH ROAD + ARMSTRONG ROAD) OCCURRED DUE TO A BRIDGE COLLAPSING. THERE ARE 2 DANGEROUS GOODS RAILCARS THAT ARE DANGLING DOWN FROM THE BRIDGE AND MAY POSSIBLY FALL IN THE RIVER. ONE (1) HOPPER CAR CONTAINS A LOAD OF ENVIRONMENTALLY HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCES (SOLID), WHILE THE OTHER RAILCAR CONTAINS A CORROSIVE SOLID PRODUCT. FIRE DEPARTMENT AND POLICE ARE ON SITE. BOTH PRODUCTS ARE SOLID, BUT FIRE DEPARTMENT CAN SEE A SHEEN ON THE RIVER. -TRANSPORT CANADA IS CURRENTLY MONITORING THIS SITUATION AND THE REGION HAS BEEN NOTIFIED. -TRANSPORT CANADA WILL PROVIDE UPDATES WHEN/IF INFORMATION BECOMES AVAILABLE. THE REPORT INDICATES THERE WAS A REPORT OF 5 RAILCARS IN THE WATER. (A POND THAT LEADS TO LAKE ONTARIO) NO TRAIN SPECIFIC INFORMATION WAS PROVIDED ON THE REPORT. WITH THE 5 CARS IN THE WATER AND THE 2 HANGING FROM THE BRIDGE, 7 CARS TOTAL HAVE BEEN REPORTEDLY DERAILED.
